title: 3 Minecraft Facts You Didn't Know 🤯 #shorts
description:
A cat voiced Minecraft's creepiest monster. 🐱
1) Minecraft's first test build (2009) was called "Cave Game."
2) The Ghast's cries are C418's cat, recorded right after it woke up.
3) The Creeper's explosions are gunshots with the pitch dropped.
Sources: C418's Reddit AMA (2011), Minecraft Wiki, PC Gamer / Twenty Thousand Hertz
#shorts #minecraft #gaming #gamingfacts #minecraftfacts
